subject: science
passage: An octopus has an unusual way of moving its copper-rich blue blood around its body. Instead of one heart, it has ______ pump blood through the gills, and the third sends it to the rest of the body. This third heart stops beating while the octopus swims, which may be one reason octopuses usually prefer to crawl.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "Instead of one heart, it has three" is a complete sentence. What follows explains how the three hearts divide the work, and it is also a complete sentence. A colon can follow a complete sentence to introduce an explanation of it.
explanation.A: Incorrect. A comma alone can't join two independent clauses; this creates a comma splice.
explanation.B: Incorrect. With no punctuation, the two independent clauses run together (a run-on sentence).
explanation.C: Correct. The colon follows a complete sentence and introduces the explanation of what the three hearts do.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Without a comma before "and," the two independent clauses run together, and "three and two" reads as if the octopus has five of something.

checks.note: solver misread: it has three: two pump blood... is grammatical
